title: Your Back Is 10x Wider Than Your Thumb, Yet Your Brain Maps Your Thumb 10x Bigger
description:
Your back is ten times wider than your thumb, yet your brain's body map flips that! Yet one surgeon mapped that hidden giant inside wide-awake patients! This is the true story of Wilder Penfield's Cortical Homunculus. Here is what went wrong with old anatomical guesses before nineteen thirty-seven.
